title: Choose Jotbook's layout
question: Same Swiss Grid world, three ways to organise notebooks. The roll dealt the focus sheet. Keep it, take another, or re-roll.

options.label: Focus sheet
options.lineage: The Prose outline, applied to pages
options.thesis: Notebook and section switch from the bar; a numbered page strip runs beside one wide note.
options.viewport: Viridian rail, a bar reading Channel / Video ideas, a 220px strip of numbered pages, and the note across the rest of the grid.
options.risk: Other notebooks are one click away instead of always on screen.

options.label: Three panes
options.thesis: Notebooks with their sections, the section's pages, then the note: everything visible at once.
options.viewport: A notebook-and-section column, a page list with first lines and dates, and the note on the grid.
options.risk: Three columns leave the note narrower, and it is the least distinctive.

options.label: Journal timeline
options.lineage: A dated index on a ruled line
options.thesis: Pages hang off a vertical ink line under oversized day numerals, so you find notes by when you wrote them.
options.viewport: Compact notebooks and sections, a timeline of days with big date numerals and their pages, and the note.
options.risk: Dates matter less than topics for some notes, such as reference pages.
